meta.name: Rugrats
meta.description: Una reinvención de la querida caricatura de los 90, Rugrats sigue a un grupo de bebés aventureros mientras descubren el gran mundo que los rodea. Liderado por Tommy Pickles, este equipo de niños pequeños explora el mundo desde su perspectiva diminuta y tremendamente imaginativa.

videos.title: Second Time Around
videos.overview: Tommy leads the babies on a daring adventure to help Chuckie after Chuckie's big attempt to be brave goes horribly wrong.

videos.title: Lady De-Clutter
videos.overview: When a "professional organizer" comes over, it's up to Tommy and his friends to stop her from taking all the toys.

videos.title: New Puppy
videos.overview: When Tommy's parents bring home a foster puppy, Tommy must find a way to keep Spike from being replaced.

videos.title: Tail of the Dogbot
videos.overview: Tommy's dad invents a robot dog that's allergy-free for Chuckie and Chas, but not necessarily problem-free.

videos.title: Jonathan for a Day
videos.overview: Angelica uses an argument between the twins to trick Phil into becoming her personal assistant.

videos.title: One Big Happy Family
videos.overview: Angelica takes advantage of a family problem to make Tommy and Chuckie play a game of house.

videos.title: The Last Balloon
videos.overview: Tommy and the babies help Chuckie take care of what he thinks is the last balloon in the whole wide world.

videos.title: March for Peas
videos.overview: When Grandpa's hurt back keeps him from his favorite event, Tommy enlists his friends to create the event at home.

videos.title: The Two Angelicas
videos.overview: Angelica's new talking doll is a shock to her and a surprise to the babies.

videos.title: No License to Drive
videos.overview: Angelica needs the babies' help adjusting to life without her Cynthia car when her car privileges are taken away.

videos.title: I Dream of Duffy
videos.overview: Tommy and his friends must keep Angelica under control when she discovers a way to get any toy she asks for.

videos.title: The Fish Stick
videos.overview: When the babies' favorite song gets 'stuck' in Chas's head, Tommy and the babies go on a quest to get it unstuck.

videos.title: The Pickle Barrel
videos.overview: Tommy and Chuckie discover that playing music might threaten their friendship.

videos.title: The Future Maker
videos.overview: Angelica uses the face filters on her phone to trick Susie into thinking she's going to turn into a taco.

videos.title: Goodbye Reptar
videos.overview: Tommy takes charge to help Chuckie send a message to his Reptar doll who they think travelled back to outer space.

videos.title: The Bubbe and Zayde Show
videos.overview: Tommy's favorite characters from a funny TV show turn out to be his visiting grandparents.

videos.title: The Perfect Myth
videos.overview: Angelica gives the babies impossible orders in a world where she is the Goddess of Perfect.

videos.title: The Big Diff
videos.overview: Tommy and Chuckie fear their friendship is over when Angelica says they're too different to be best friends.

videos.title: Final Eclipse
videos.overview: Susie, Tommy, and Chuckie must defeat an "outer space villain" while at a sci-fi movie convention with their dads.

videos.title: Great Minds Think Alike
videos.overview: Susie and Angelica disagree on how to use their newfound "super" ability to move things with their minds.

videos.title: Betty and the Beast
videos.overview: Tommy and his friends fear Tommy's daddy has turned into a fantastical beast and it's up to them to turn him back.

videos.title: Escape from Preschool
videos.overview: Tommy leads his friends on a daring mission to break Angelica free from her preschool.

videos.title: Mr. Chuckie
videos.overview: When Chuckie turns into a grown-up overnight, Tommy gets him to take the babies out on the town.

videos.title: The Werewoof Hunter
videos.overview: Tommy needs his friends' help to save Angelica after she turns into a werewolf at a scary Halloween party where their parents seem to be disappearing one by one.

videos.title: Traditions
videos.overview: When Tommy's first Hanukkah falls on Christmas Eve, the Pickles family has to juggle their family traditions to make sure each feels important, while also celebrating Las Posadas with Betty and her family.

videos.title: Chuckie vs. the Vacuum
videos.overview: After Chuckie defeats a vacuum monster, he wonders if he's conquered ALL his fears.

videos.title: Gone Teddy Gone
videos.overview: When Tommy’s teddy bear mysteriously disappears, Angelica steps in as detective to find the culprit.

videos.title: I, Baby
videos.overview: A mysterious beeping sound leads Susie and the babies to believe Chuckie might be a robot.

videos.title: Fan-Gelica
videos.overview: After a video of Angelica sharing goes viral, she has to pretend to love sharing to keep her fame alive.

videos.title: Captain Susie
videos.overview: Susie must face her greatest fears as she leads the babies on a daring mission in outer space.

videos.title: Bringing Up Daisy
videos.overview: Chuckie discovers his green thumb when Angelica discards a gift.

videos.title: Wedding Smashers
videos.overview: While planning Cynthia’s wedding, Phil realizes his friends treat him and Lil a little differently.

videos.title: House Broken
videos.overview: When Stu accidentally tinkers with Duffy, it’s up to Tommy and the babies to make the house safe again.

videos.title: Lucky Smudge
videos.overview: Angelica uses Tommy as a good luck charm at her school carnival.

videos.title: Our Friend Twinkle
videos.overview: Spooky things start happening in the Pickles’ house when Phil and Lil’s friend Twinkle shows up.

videos.title: Rescuing Cynthia
videos.overview: When Angelica accidentally leaves her Cynthia doll at home, she goes on a fantastical journey to find her but learns that everyone has forgotten Cynthia for a new popstar named Tabitha.

videos.title: Queen Bee
videos.overview: While Randy and Lucy film a movie about bees, the babies and Angelica form a hive of their own.

videos.title: Phone Alone
videos.overview: In order to win a contest, Angelica enlists the babies to find their parents’ hidden phones.

videos.title: Night Crawler
videos.overview: Tommy and Chuckie set out to find a dinosaur they think lives in Tommy’s house at night.

videos.title: Goblets & Goblins
videos.overview: Angelica convinces Tommy and the babies to search for treasure in a world where goblins live.

videos.title: House of Cardboard
videos.overview: Angelica and Chuckie are surprised to find they feel the same way about decorating a cardboard playhouse.

videos.title: Fluffy Moves In
videos.overview: A new pet cat proves to be the only creature in the world who can out-Angelica Angelica.

videos.title: Susie the Artist
videos.overview: When Susie’s artistic talent steals Angelica’s spotlight, Angelica tries to end Susie’s artistic career.

videos.title: A Horse is a Horse
videos.overview: Tommy and his friends get back on track after Grandpa brings home a trained miniature horse.

videos.title: Mini-Mommy
videos.overview: Phil and Lil think their mommy is turning back into a kid when Tia Esperanza gives Betty a toy for Día De Los Niños

videos.title: No Talking
videos.overview: The babies enjoy an unusually quiet day after Angelica loses her voice - meanwhile, Kimi isn't much help as her translator.

videos.title: The Climb
videos.overview: Susie entertains her friends with the story of Jackie, who climbs a magic beanstalk and meets a cranky, sleep deprived giant.

videos.title: Wolf at the Door
videos.overview: Susie the House-Finder shows baker Chuckie some house-bakery options, but a big bad wolf named Angelica has other plans.

videos.title: A Tiger's Tale
videos.overview: When Spike appears to have transformed into a wild tiger, Tommy tries to tame him so he can stay in the Pickles' house.

videos.title: Grandchild of the Month
videos.overview: Angelica runs a campaign to be elected "Grandchild of the Month" at Grandpa Lou's senior center, with Begley as her advisor.

videos.title: Bookworm
videos.overview: Booky the Bookworm arrives at the library to read the kids a story, but Phil loses his pet worm Todd Jr. in the excitement.

videos.title: The Cookie Test
videos.overview: Angelica tries to teach Chuckie and Kimi how to speak up for what they want, since they're going to be living together.

videos.title: Mudville
videos.overview: Darsh shows Phil and Lil that they have individual talents and the twins soon question their entire dynamic as a duo.

videos.title: Stepping Stone
videos.overview: Angelica's plan to befriend Nyra backfires when she accidentally gets herself labeled as Darsh's friend instead.

videos.title: Scooped
videos.overview: Susie and her friends travel into the magical world of her grandfather's book to help Robby get to Ice Cream Mountain.

videos.title: Class Pet
videos.overview: Kimi is thrilled to take home her preschool's bearded dragon, but soon learns that she doesn't enjoy the responsibility.

videos.title: Desert Trip
videos.overview: Phil and Lil learn that they're meeting their "Howard" this weekend and when the dads take the babies on a camping trip out into the desert, the babies try to figure out who the twins' "Howard" really is... might he even be an alien from outer space?

videos.title: Wild Doll
videos.overview: Angelica's parents give her and Cynthia a timeout for misbehaving but Cynthia refuses to accept her consequences and runs amok.

videos.title: The Pest Plant
videos.overview: Tommy, jealous of the attention Dil is getting, wishes a Venus flytrap would eat his brother, but then regrets doing so.

videos.title: Forest Friends
videos.overview: Susie is embarrassed to be caught playing with Angelica, so she makes up a fake twin sister as a cover story.

videos.title: Castle Guy
videos.overview: The babies investigate strange sounds coming from Darsh's closet and discover a hidden castle with an inhabitant who doesn't want to leave.

videos.title: Tricycle Kid
videos.overview: Pierce and Tricycle Kid rave about a new toy to the other kids, but Tommy's not convinced by this supposed "right way to play."

videos.title: Simply Simon
videos.overview: When Angelica's uncle Simon returns and claims he's changed his bratty ways, Angelica tries to prove he's lying.

videos.title: New Year on Ice
videos.overview: On New Year's Day, the group goes to a live performance of "Reptar in Space on Ice: The Musical Experience." Chuckie and Kimi worry that becoming one family means they can only do things one way, but they have different plans for how to help Reptar.

videos.title: Flower Girl
videos.overview: Angelica, envious that Kimi gets to be a flower girl at Chas and Kira's wedding, tries to figure out a way to be one too.

videos.title: Flight of the Finster
videos.overview: Chuckie is happy to let his big sister Kimi be overprotective of him, but soon realizes that life on "easy mode" is no fun.

videos.title: The Toy Box
videos.overview: The babies travel to Toyland and find their toys have come to life... but Tommy and Chuckie have been turned into toys themselves.

videos.title: The Pit
videos.overview: When Phil gets stuck in a pit, the babies wonder why Lil would rather chase a porcupine than help get her brother out.

videos.title: Dinner Guest
videos.overview: Susie hosts a dinner party for her friends, but her special guest Bonesy (a model skeleton from Randy's classroom) goes missing.

videos.title: Bucket List
videos.overview: Darsh thinks he'll be starting preschool soon, so he tries to fit every activity into this final day with his friends.

videos.title: Big Cake Day (1)
videos.overview: When a broken vase threatens to ruin Chas and Kira's wedding, Angelica and an unseen Wise Fox lead the babies around the world to fix it.

videos.title: Big Cake Day (2)
videos.overview: In the end, the babies and Angelica learn they need each other.

videos.title: Tommy's Ball
videos.overview: Angelica kicks Tommy's new ball over the fence.

videos.title: Night Howl
videos.overview: Spike wakes up Tommy for a secret nighttime outing to see the full moon.

videos.title: The Stars of Rugrats Special
videos.overview: Join the voice stars from the original show as they reunite and talk all about the new series. Plus - find out who wins at Rugrats trivia, and watch a table read of a fan favorite scene.

videos.title: The Lamp
videos.overview: Tommy and his friends get Angelica to confess that she broke a lamp.

videos.title: The Slide
videos.overview: At the playground, Chuckie must face his fear of going down the slide.

videos.title: Reptar in Space
videos.overview: Reptar must save planet Earth from destruction by aliens.

videos.title: Art Project
videos.overview: Angelica tricks Tommy and his friends into embellishing Didi's sculpture.

videos.title: The Expedition
videos.overview: Tommy leads his friends on an expedition to find treasure on a mountaintop.

videos.title: The Cynthia Show
videos.overview: Angelica pretends to be a guest on Cynthia's talk show, but keeps getting interrupted by Tommy and his friends.

videos.title: Big Night
videos.overview: Kimi thinks her mama has forgotten to bring her to dinner, so the babies embark on a road trip to the restaurant with her. This was originally set to premiere on Nicktoons on March 26, 2024. It along with its paired episode, No, No, Nana were delayed from release. It was released on DVD, October 8, 2024

videos.title: No, No, Nana
videos.overview: Angelica's nana Judith comes to town and takes a "yes and" approach to babysitting, indulging all of Angelica's reckless ideas. This episode was originally set to premiere on Nicktoons on March 26, 2024. It, along with its paired episode, Big Night were delayed from release. It was released on DVD October 8, 2024.

videos.title: The Sleepover
videos.overview:
Tommy spends the night at Phil's and Lil's and is surprised to learn that there's no "sleep" during a sleepover-only partying!

This episode was originally set to premiere on Nicktoons on March 26, 2024. It, along with its paired episode, The Favor were delayed from release. It was released on DVD October 8, 2024.

videos.title: The Favor
videos.overview:
After Susie rescues Josh's stick sword, he owes her a favor, but none of his attempts to pay her back are very nice.

Tommy spends the night at Phil's and Lil's and is surprised to learn that there's no "sleep" during a sleepover-only partying!

This episode was originally set to premiere on Nicktoons on March 26, 2024. It, along with its paired episode, The Sleepover were delayed from release. It was released on DVD October 8, 2024.

videos.title: Chuckie Come Home (1)
videos.overview: This two-part episode was originally set to premiere on Nicktoons on March 26, 2024, but was delayed from release. It was released on DVD, October 8, 2024

videos.title: Chuckie Come Home (2)
videos.overview: This two-part episode was originally set to premiere on Nicktoons on March 26, 2024, but was delayed from release. It was released on DVD, October 8, 2024
